description: Post the day's progress, only after the user explicitly said to post. text is the day's post as the user edited it, for Bluesky (default: the draft from get_post_draft). wip_todos are the WIP todos as the user edited them, each with the key from the draft (default: the draft's todos; with text and no wip_todos, WIP gets text as one todo). Goes to the networks chosen in settings, or the ones given. A network where the user already posted that day themselves is skipped. Each day goes to each network (on WIP, each project) once: a retry never posts twice. Today or yesterday only. Pro.

networks.description: default: the networks chosen in settings
